title: NKNEST Lounge Chair $429 (Was $699) + Matching Ottoman on Selected Fabrics + Delivery ($0 to Metro) @ NKNEST
body:
Deal: NKNEST Lounge Chair $429 (Was $699) + Matching Ottoman on Selected Fabrics + Delivery ($0 to Metro) @ NKNEST

[Slo20] 503 error from 10 people clicking on the link. I think you may need a better provider.
[showwwww] Thank you for your reply. The website has now been fixed.
[mmrazz] Your website is dead. However the last time Google indexed it (likely within the last few weeks) it recorded that
Original price was: $699.00
Current price is: $429.00.
Which makes $459 seem like less of a deal…
According to Gemini :
The item has historically launched at a baseline price of $699.00 AUD across all available colors (including Off White, Dark Grey, Light Grey, Pink, and Caramel Brown). However, it is regularly kept on an ongoing promotional discount for $429.00 AUD.
Note: NKNEST occasionally includes limited-time incentives, such as a free matching square ottoman automatically applied at checkout
[showwwww] Thank you for your reply. The website has now been fixed.
[mmrazz] In case anyone reading this now is confused…
This deal was originally posted at $459, down from $729. After I called them out, they've apparently changed it to $429 down from $699 - just like it seems that the price has always been (eg, they have a post on facebook at the 699->429 price 2 weeks ago). No acknowledge of the price change from the OP, but if you look at the original post you can see it was edited about 45 minutes after originally being posted (and about 25 mins after my post above) - check the revisions and you can see the change of price.
I hadn't downvoted it previously, but changing the deal without any acknowledgement deserves a downvote…
[m9] Thanks. Neg for the misleading price comparison.
[bogak] Cheaping out on website infra isn't a good idea if you're trying to sell stuff.
[Master Bates] $89 at Kmart:
Faux Fur Cream Expanding Chair
Expanding Chair Green Corduroy
[Master Bates] Smaller than OP’s, but certainly not tiny:
Kmart: 60cm (H) × 90cm (W) × 83cm (D)
NKNEST: 87cm (H) × 113cm (W) × 113cm (D)
That’s a difference of 27cm (H) × 23cm (W) × 30cm (D) for a $340.99 price difference ($429.99 vs $89).
I understand there’s no point buying a chair that’s too small to be usable, but I’m not convinced this qualifies as a deal.
[OZKap] Why do your posed product photos contain "ChatGPT-Image" in the filename?
Why do the photos accompanying your customer reviews flag positive for SynthID, indicating that they were generated by OpenAI or Google tools?
Even image 3.png, a simple image of the chair on a white background
Generated with OpenAI tools
This content was generated using OpenAI tools. The signals below provide supporting evidence for this result.
Model:
gpt-image
Generated:
Jul 11, 2026, 10:00 AM GMT+10
SynthID detected
We found a SynthID watermark that originated from OpenAI.
Content Credentials detected
We found a trusted C2PA manifest that originated from OpenAI.
[Nom] Because they used AI to generate their website content, exactly like you would expect them to in the year 2026 ?
This seems like a weird thing to call out, using AI to generate content isn't novel or interesting today 🤷
[OZKap] Using AI to generate customer review pictures?
[Nom] Would not surprise me in the slightest - people are using AI to take shortcuts in literally everything.
[OZKap] @Nom: And you think it's a weird thing for me to call out that a seller is using ai-generated customer review images when advertising on ozbargain.com.au, Australia's largest bargain sharing website?
You think it's not novel or interesting that there isn't a single actual picture of what this product looks like?
[Nom] @OZKap: I was responding to your assertion that they were using AI. This is normal and expected.
I don't think it's weird to call out fake customer reviews.
Complaint is valid. Please proceed 👍
[Lizard Spock] @OZKap: There's not even any dimensions that I can find on their "website".
I'm going to have to neg. Fake AI generated reviews (the long dashes are a dead give away) and the repeated similar wording used. There are no specific item dimensions given and frankly, the whole thing seems dishonest.
[thatguyfromthatplace] It's a block of foam with no frame or springs. The margins on this must be ridiculous.
[BargainsGrabber] How can the “48 viewing this right now” stay the same always?
And the “275 people has purchased this in 7 days”
Very suspicious
